_note: Hosted models via OpenRouter. OpenRouter lists no Gemma 4 E2B or E4B (checked 9 Nov 2026), so these are the closest Google sizes, labelled as such. Prices are USD per million tokens from OpenRouter's list on 9 Nov 2026; recorded costs come from the usage.cost the API returns. tool_mode: native where the model supports tool calling (Gemma 4 answers in its own call syntax under the text protocol), text where it does not.
